== Notes ==
* Each damage [[packet]]'s reduction is calculated individually, even from a single skill or attack.
* [[Health degeneration]], [[life stealing]], and [[health loss]] are not damage and therefore not affected by the damage reduction or cap.
* Can be used with [[Protective Spirit]] for [[55]] builds, as long as Protective Spirit is (re-)applied before Shadow Form every time.
* [[Summoned creature|Creatures summoned]] by the caster, such as minions and spirits, deal full damage.
{{bug|The -5 damage reduction is active for the ''expected'' duration of each enchantment, not its ''actual'' duration. Refreshing an Assassin enchantment before it ends reduces the received damage by an additional -5.}}

== Trivia ==
* The left hand of the figure in the [[skill icon]] is similar to the hand in the icons for the skills [[Enduring Toxin]] and [[Reaper's Mark]].
* The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Shadow Form/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
